summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback transaction details provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B common stock. The filing reiterates the program's aggregate authorization and notes ongoing repurchases, with forward-looking statements on intent. No specific share numbers, prices, or dates were detailed. The company acts as issuer repurchasing its own shares. What to watch: pace of repurchases relative to authorization and any impact on share count or liquidity, with no arbitrage angle as this is an ongoing buyback disclosure.
